# Metro

> > Metro is a UK-based news and entertainment website covering breaking news, sport, lifestyle, entertainment, and viral content for a modern audience.

Metro.co.uk is the digital home of Metro, Britain's most widely read newspaper, delivering news, sports coverage (including football, horse racing, and the Cheltenham Festival), entertainment, travel features, and viral explainer articles. The site covers major UK and international stories, from politics and business to pop culture and lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Metro News
- Football and Premier League
- Cheltenham Festival and Gold Cup
- Horse racing
- Transfer news
- London
- Travel destinations (Dubai, Lanzarote)
- Viral content and explainers
- Pop culture and Star Wars
- Ramadan and cultural celebrations
- Conspiracy theory debunking
- UK retail (Sainsbury's)
- International news (Putin, Iran)
- Spa and lifestyle features

## Sport

- [Sport - Latest news, rumours and updates on football, snooker, boxing and more](https://metro.co.uk/sport/): Main sports section covering football, Cheltenham Festival, and more

## Viral & Explainer Content

- [Here are 10 'proofs' that the Earth is actually flat, not round | Metro News](https://metro.co.uk/2016/07/19/here-are-10-proofs-that-the-earth-is-actually-flat-not-round-6016710/): Viral article debunking flat-earth conspiracy theory claims
- [What does 'May the force be with you' mean and what is the reply? | Metro News](https://metro.co.uk/2017/05/04/what-does-may-the-force-be-with-you-mean-and-what-is-the-traditional-reply-6615175/): Explainer on Star Wars phrase meaning for May the Fourth celebration
- [What does 'Ramadan Mubarak' mean and how do you wish a Happy Ramadan? | Metro News](https://metro.co.uk/2022/04/02/what-does-ramadan-mubarak-mean-and-how-do-you-wish-a-happy-ramadan-16357449/): Guide to Ramadan greetings and Islamic phrases for the holy month
